basic_info.main_problem: 在参演的一部电影上映后票房/口碑not佳,立即将失败归因于自己的表演,出现强烈自责与个人化,进而发展为Self-doubt与对作为Actor/Artist的才能的质疑;每当想到该电影或自己的演技时加重,重看影片并分析表现使自责加剧.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling to deal with these negative thinking patterns, and to learn how to separate self-worth from external success or failure.
growth_experiences: 大学退学(约一月前):因感觉难以跟上课程,反复被他人学业成就triggerSense of frustration而做出退学决定;退学后持续感到'自己是失败者',在看到同龄人毕业或学业顺利时情绪更为低落,常以回避相关话题来应对.
参演的电影上映后表现not佳:将电影失败直接归因于自己的演出,压力与自责显著增高;尝试通过重看电影并分析自己的镜头来寻找原因,结果加重自责与without望感,影响片场自信,人际互动与自尊.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on external success or failure

special_situations.event: 参演的电影上映后票房/口碑not佳
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果作品失败,就说明是我表现not好,我要为结果负责
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复Reflection并自责,试图通过自我苛责来'改正错误'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 电影扑街都是因为我演得not好

special_situations.event: Seeing peers graduate or succeed academically
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not像同龄人那样完成学位,I am just a failure,not yet来也not可能成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids topics and occasions involving academics / success, reduces communication with others to avoid comparison
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远拿not到学位,我就是not行

special_situations.event: Rewatches the film and focuses on one's own shots for frame-by-frame analysis
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I examine myself carefully enough, I will surely find the mistakes that caused the failure, thereby proving that I really am bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-analyzes and picks faults, ignoring other factors and positive parts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: See, my performance really was terrible; I dragged down the whole film

special_situations.event: Thinking about their acting skills or professional abilities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not是一直成功,就证明我have not能力/天赋
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用全盘negate来简化复杂问题,降低not确定感

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与肯定,作为Actor/Artist被看见其价值
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因失败而被negate与羞辱,被他人看轻,最终被排斥
defense_goal: 通过自责与内化批评来先行惩罚自己以避免外界更痛的negate
保持Withdrawal与回避,降低被比较与被评判的风险
以Intellectualization分析取代情绪体验,减少羞耻与without力感

object_relations.self_representation: 失败者/not够好,需要not断证明自己的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 会评判和negate自己的他人(同龄毕业者,同行,观众)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of or being reminded of the box-office failure
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将失败归结为'It is all my fault',并Anticipation他人会因此看轻自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和并先行Empathy其自责与压力;再邀请探索其他可能因素,用开放式问题扩展证据,避免直接反驳其感受.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 为减轻not安而反复重看并技术性分析自己的镜头
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 相信只要通过理性分析就能控制Anxiety,避免直面羞耻与悲伤
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Slowing the pace, inviting them to name present emotions and body sensations; staying briefly with the emotion before returning to thinking while maintaining safety, reducing the tendency to analyze immediately.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing sensitive topics such as academics/success with others
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心被比较与被negate,将情绪与话题切割,选择回避或简短回应
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 确保关系安全与节制的节奏,use温和的反映与情感标注,给予选择权,鼓励小步暴露而非强推深入.

manifestations: Tightly binds self-worth to external success or failure (movie box office, academic achievement)
电影失败后质疑自身作为Actor/Artist的意义与能力
在与同龄人的比较中感到without望与Self-deprecation
